### Heat Maps of the United States

#### Total Deaths

```{r}
#install.packages(c("ggplot2", "sf", "tidyverse", "ggmap", "maps", "mapdata"))
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggmap)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
```

```{r}
register_stadiamaps("aa2920a3-11e4-475e-82c1-18552c632fd2", write = FALSE)
```

```{r}
state_map <- map_data("state")
state_map
```


```{r}
state_names <- data.frame(State = state.abb,
                          region = tolower(state.name))
```

```{r}
state_deaths <- left_join(usa_data, state_names, by = "State")
```

```{r}
total_deaths_per_state <- state_deaths %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarize(total_deaths = sum(Deaths))
```

```{r}
usa_map <- left_join(state_map, total_deaths_per_state, by = "region")
```

```{r}
us_bbox <- c(left = -125, bottom = 25, right = -66, top = 50)
us_map <- get_stadiamap(us_bbox, zoom =5, maptype= "stamen_toner_lite")
ggmap(us_map)
```

```{r}
ggmap(us_map)+
  geom_polygon(data = usa_map,
               aes(x = long, y= lat, group = group, fill = total_deaths),
               color = "black", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7)+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")+
  labs(title = "Alcohol-Related Deaths by State",
     x = "Longitude",
     y = "Latitude") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1))+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=rel(1.5),hjust=0.5))
```

#### Deaths By Effect Duration (Chronic or Acute)

```{r}
us_data_State_total_deaths_by_effect_duration <- usa_data %>% 
  group_by(Effect_Duration, State) %>% 
  summarize(total_death_by_effect_duration = sum(Deaths)) %>% 
  select(Effect_Duration, State, total_death_by_effect_duration)

effect_duration_deaths <- left_join(us_data_State_total_deaths_by_effect_duration, state_names, by = "State")

state_center <- state_map %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(center_long = mean(long, na.rm = TRUE),
            center_lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

u_map <- left_join(effect_duration_deaths, state_center, by = "region")

us_bbox <- c(left = -125, bottom = 25, right = -66, top = 50)
us_map <- get_stadiamap(us_bbox, zoom =5, maptype= "stamen_toner_lite")
ggmap(us_map)

ggmap(us_map)+
  geom_polygon(data = state_map,
               aes(x = long, y= lat, group = group), fill = "gray", color = "black", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_point(data = u_map,
             aes(x=center_long, y=center_lat, size = total_death_by_effect_duration, color= Effect_Duration),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.5, height = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.7,  stroke = 1, shape = 21, fill = "white", na.rm=TRUE)+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Chronic" = "red", "Acute" = "blue"))+
  labs(title = "Alcohol-Related Deaths by State by Effect Duration",
     x = "Longitude",
     y = "Latitude") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1))+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=rel(1.5),hjust=0.5))
```
##### Bubble Plot of Alcohol-Related Deaths by Age

```{r}
usa_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = Deaths, size = Effect_Duration, color = Effect_Duration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Chronic" = 4, "Acute" = 2)) +
  labs(title = "Alcohol-Related Deaths by Age (Bubble Chart)",
       x = "Age Group",
       y = "Number of Deaths",
       size = "Effect Duration") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1))+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=rel(1.5),hjust=0.5))
```
